items.title: Breaking a Problem into Smaller Parts (Decomposition)

source_refs.note: Unnumbered heading under 2.2, as printed on printed page 21 (missing from this scan; read from a second copy of the book, Study++ scan PDF 24).

blocks.text: Breaking a problem into smaller parts is called decomposition. A big problem can be difficult to solve at once. Smaller parts are easier to understand and manage. Each part can be solved step by step. This reduces confusion and stress. Decomposition helps us organize our thoughts. It allows us to focus on one task at a time. This method is widely used in computer science and daily activities.
